rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for appreciating someone’s qualities, work, or beauty.

example.english: I really admire the way you painted this picture
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 jan1 soeng2 nei5 waa2 ni1 fuk1 waa2

rows.note: Choose this for strong respect, especially for someone’s ability, achievement, or character.

example.english: I really admire you for making time to help people even when you are so busy
example.traditional: 你咁忙都抽時間幫人 我真係佩服你
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 mong4 dou1 cau1 si4 gaan3 bong1 jan4 ngo5 zan1 hai6 pui3 fuk6 nei5

rows.note: Use this for looking up to or being deeply attracted to an admired person, especially in elevated or literary contexts.

example.english: Many younger writers admire this author
example.traditional: 不少後輩仰慕呢位作家
example.jyutping: bat1 siu2 hau6 bui3 joeng5 mou6 ni1 wai2 zok3 gaa1

rows.note: Use this when the admiration specifically involves being amazed or filled with wonder.

example.english: I could not help but admire the view in front of me from the mountaintop
example.traditional: 我企喺山頂 忍唔住驚嘆眼前嘅景色
example.jyutping: ngo5 kei5 hai2 saan1 deng2 jan2 m4 zyu6 ging1 taan3 ngaan5 cin4 ge3 ging2 sik1
